configurations.name: kimono
configurations.comment: The front end. It proxies /api and /admin to the API, so run `npm run server` alongside it or every call 404s — the counts stay at their fallbacks and Reserve fails.

configurations.name: kimono-api
configurations.comment: The API and /admin. Serves no page: / is a 404 by design.

configurations.name: kimono-single
configurations.comment: One process serving everything: the API, /admin and the built site from dist/. Needs `npm run build` first. This is the shape the deployment takes — single origin, so no CORS and no SameSite=None.
